_about: Mutation-test targets for this plugin. Each target names the file to mutate and
the test command that must notice a change (the fast suite that covers it).
Run with tools/mutator.py, or as part of tools/run_tests.sh.
min_kill_rate is the floor: below it the run fails, and a target that yields no
mutants at all fails too, so a mutation pass can never be green over nothing.
per_operator caps how many occurrences of each operator are mutated (determinism
and runtime); raise it for a deeper nightly run via --max-rate/--only.
exempt lists shipped sources that are deliberately not mutated, each with a reason;
policy_check's tests/no-gaps rule requires every source_globs match to be accounted
for here or be a target.
equivalent lists mutants that are genuinely UNOBSERVABLE, each with the mechanism.
Every entry was proven by measurement, not asserted: the mutant was applied to a
temp copy and the target's FULL test output diffed against the baseline (identical
once unittest's elapsed-time line is normalised). An unproven entry here would be
exactly the accounting trick mutation testing exists to prevent.

equivalent.reason: the digit in the fd redirection 2>&1 (have() discards stderr); 3>&1 opens an unused descriptor and changes nothing. Proven: mutant applied, full shell-test output byte-identical to the baseline.
